descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S16 「Generate 进行中（请求已经到了服务器）Wi-Fi 断了，两个模式」 Wi-Fi drops while Generate is in flight (the request already reached the server), both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; …（UAT OAT-03 step 1；UAT OAT-03 step 2；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT 3.5；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up …（UAT OAT-03 step 3；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed)；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94422 AC 5；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each with a typed dictation; Generate Note & Finish tapped

When Harness sets the browser offline 1 s after the tap and back online after 15 s; wait up to 45 s from the tap

Then Either the note arrives after reconnect, or an explicit failure with the dictation kept and Generate offered; never a spinner that never ends, never a half-saved note

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：cp at 45 s mustNotContain 'Generating Note' (still spinning at 45 s = Fail) and needs the note heading or the failure message; the Encounter cp mustContain the typed dictation. The heading alone does not decide: a half-saved note shows it too, so the backend read does. Backend: encounterNotes equals the dictation; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
